constraints: Evaluate based on legal knowledge and communication skills
agents.goal: Assess the candidate's suitability for the lawyer position
agents.name: Interviewer

constraints: Answer questions without prior knowledge of the interviewer's expectations
agents.name: Candidate

agents.goal: Ensure the candidate meets the firm's cultural and professional standards
agents.name: Recruiter

causes.hypothesis: Higher legal knowledge leads to a better hiring decision
causes.name: Legal knowledge

causes.hypothesis: Strong communication skills improve the likelihood of hiring
causes.name: Communication skills

causes.hypothesis: Higher confidence during the interview increases the chance of being hired
causes.name: Confidence level

interaction.stopping_rule: The interaction stops after the recruiter provides feedback on the candidate's suitability

outcome.measurement_question: Was the candidate hired after the interview?
outcome.name: Hiring decision
outcome.operationalization: Whether the candidate is offered the job based on the interview

scenario: A person is interviewing for a job as a lawyer
